And Then

New series! "And Then” finds Ed Baxter and Michael Umney in conversation about Resonance FM. Episode 1/8: "A second life around your life." This series was commissioned by the Independent Community Radio Network and was supported by the Nordic Culture Point "Nordic-Baltic Mobility Programme for Culture." Produced by Michael Umney and Ed Baxter. [Repeats Saturday 8.15am.]
